description: This Java class defines a configuration object for associating an issuer string with a SubjectIssuer instance, used in JWT authentication within the security module of the Eclipse Ditto services gateway.

classes.name: JwtSubjectIssuerConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class holding issuer and SubjectIssuer details for JWT token validation and processing.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer string associated with this configuration.

methods.name: getSubjectIssuer
methods.description: Returns the SubjectIssuer object associated with this configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between this object and another, based on issuer and subjectIssuer fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides a hash code based on issuer and subjectIssuer fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the JwtSubjectIssuerConfig object with its class name, issuer, and subjectIssuer.
